svg.title: Oscillating water-column plant — Ölduvirkjun með sveiflukenndri vatnssúlu
svg.desc: A partly submerged chamber encloses a rising water surface beneath an air outlet and a small air turbine.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Sectors and Nature","subject":"power-oscillating-water-column","label_en":"Oscillating water-column plant","label_is":"Ölduvirkjun með sveiflukenndri vatnssúlu","section":"06","category_en":"Power plants and generation","category_is":"Orkuver og orkuframleiðsla","batch":3,"tags":["power","wave"],"description":"A partly submerged chamber encloses a rising water surface beneath an air outlet and a small air turbine.","design_note":"The water-filled chamber compresses the air above it, a different visible mechanism from floating-body converters.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
